basis: The initial PASS label came from the implementing agent, not independent human gold. The initial live run failed its positive-label assertion (2/3 positives passed). Both unprimed observations identified changes inside the curled tail plus palette flicker. Full unchanged frames enlarged6x confirm that tail tip/internal contour changes across 0,1,4,6,8 despite fixed outer bounds. The quiet-idle requirement rejects this motion. No thresholds or images were changed to force a pass. The failing first run is preserved; this adjudication is not independent proof of overall accuracy.
